conf.description: M365 UAL sharepoint-onedrive csv-file: batch export, AuditData JSON extract, RecordType reconciliation, origin tag, pagination/noise columns stripped

conf.comment: M365 UAL sharepoint-onedrive, csv-file format (Purview export or Search-UnifiedAuditLog|Export-Csv; backfill/manual-export lane). Extract-JSON on the AuditData string column, reconcile RecordType (numeric or string enum name) to the same 4/6/14 codes as the json feed (oneDrive undocumented numerically, falls to -1, a documented gap), strip pagination/PowerShell noise columns. Per direct.cribl: tag with an origin marker to stay distinct from the live feed on this highest-volume content type, where double-counting from a re-imported CSV matters most.

functions.description: decode the AuditData JSON-string column in place into an object
batch rename of straightforward mapped/partial fields to their ECS targets
canonical event time in _time (never @timestamp; Elastic dest maps it)
computed transforms, custom-field routing, and event.dataset
